scope_policy: Named places, watercourses, roads, historical facilities, personal-name labels, printed heights, literal geological descriptions and the survey caveat. Excludes marginal legends/graticule, geological unit codes, report references and bare dip/strike numerals. Printed names do not establish ownership or modern feature positions.
